title_lines: 前美国联邦贸易委员会
批最高法裁决权力大转移
从国会到总统，令人不安

subtitles.en: And joining us now for more on the slaughter case specifically is its namesake Rebecca Kelly slaughter, the fired FTC commissioner by President Trump who of course fought that and took it all
subtitles.zh: 现在加入我们讨论斯劳特案的是其同名者丽贝卡·凯利·斯劳特，她被特朗普总统解雇了FTC委员职务，当然她对此提出异议并一路抗争到最高法院，最终导致了昨天的裁决。

subtitles.en: the way to the Supreme Court challenge that of course ended with this ruling yesterday. Welcome back to Bloomberg TV and radio commissioner when we consider President Trump's words about your case
subtitles.zh: 欢迎回到彭博电视和广播，委员。当我们考虑特朗普总统关于你的案件和法院裁决的言论时，他称这是法院做出的最重要、最具影响力的裁决，并说这赋予了总统巨大的额外权力。

subtitles.en: and the court's ruling. He called it the biggest and most consequential decision issued by the court which he says gives tremendous additional power back to the presidency. Is that the right
subtitles.zh: 这个描述准确吗？是的，我认为这完全准确，也正是为什么我认为这个裁决如此令人不安。这是从国会向总统的大规模权力转移。

subtitles.en: characterization? Yes, I think that's exactly the right characterization and it's exactly why I think the ruling is so disturbing. It is a massive transfer of power from Congress
subtitles.zh: 这种转移将国会设立为人民服务并对人民负责的机构，变成了权力者和行政部门的工具。

subtitles.en: to the president and it's a transfer that transforms these agencies that Congress set up to work for and be accountable to the people into instruments of the powerful and of the executives.
subtitles.zh: 有意思，丽贝卡，你竟然在直播中同意唐纳德·特朗普的观点。感谢你回到彭博与我们交谈。

subtitles.en: Well, kind of interesting to hear you agree with Donald Trump in a live conversation, Rebecca. Thank you for coming back to talk to us here on Bloomberg. What's
subtitles.zh: 这会导致什么结果？大门每四到八年就会摇摆一次。不仅仅是政府更迭，而是整个行政国家都在变化？是的，我认为完全正确。

subtitles.en: what's the result of this? The door keeps swinging every four to eight years. It's not just the administration that changes but the entire administrative state? Yeah, I think that's exactly right
subtitles.zh: 我认为重要的是回顾历史，理解这不是一个党派问题，当然也不应该成为党派问题。昨天被推翻的案件，汉弗莱案……

subtitles.en: and I think it's important to go back to the history and understand that this is not a partisan issue and it certainly shouldn't be a partisan issue. The case that was overturned yesterday, Humphrey's
subtitles.zh: 回顾历史很重要，要明白这不是党派问题，也绝不应成为党派问题。昨天被推翻的案例是Humphrey's
